basic_info.description: Nestled in the heart of Duboce Triangle, one of the city's most vibrant neighborhoods and adjacent to Noe Slow Street, the cottage welcomes you through its gate, lush gardens & outdoor decks. Once home to livestock beneath its floorboards, it now stands as a testament to thoughtful restoration & urban charm, where 19th-century carriage house meets 21st-century precision with soul & smart updates. Key features include: completely detached with windows on all 4 sides for natural light and pretty outlooks; fully updated infrastructure: every system from foundation/electrical/plumbing has been meticulously modernized for peace of mind and long-term comfort; south-facing garden with sunshine to enjoy your own private green oasis from several decks or a fire pit, perfect for morning coffee, weekend gatherings, or remote work breaks. Bohemian elegance with original architectural details blend seamlessly with curated finishes, offering a warm, creative ambiance that feels both grounded and unpretentious. The prime location is surrounded by the Castro/Hayes Valley/NOPA/Mission, steps from artisanal coffee, indie boutiques/great eateries. The house is tech-ready w/smart home integrations/flexible offices. Add unit/in-law/income? Zoned RH3 allows 3 dwelling unit+1ADU for many possibilities.
